newsitem.title: USA: American Stone applies to list on SmallCap.
newsitem.headline: American Stone applies to list on SmallCap.

text.p: American Stone Industries Inc said its board has approved a previously announced reverse stock split to comply with the listing criteria for the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.
The company filed its application to trade on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market on April 15. The company expects the listing application to be approved by NASD within the next several months.
The company will distribute one new share of stock for each ten shares of old stock on May 30 to shareholders of record on May 19.
American Stone Industries is a holding company that mines and sells stone predominantly for the building stone market through its wholly owned subsidiary, American Stone Corp.
